General guidance on health, insurance, documents and arrangements. Exact requirements depend on your situation and project.
Last checked: November 2026. Rules can change — confirm current requirements with the relevant authorities or providers.
The EHIC and travel insurance: two separate checks
For a temporary stay in Europe, ask your health insurer whether you are entitled to a European Health Insurance Card (EHIC) and whether it is valid for your trip. The EHIC is not travel insurance and does not cover repatriation.
Check that your travel insurance suits your destination, duration and activities, including limits and exclusions. For a group, agree who checks cover.
Documents and participants
Check identity documents, entry requirements and any permissions for minors with the relevant authorities.
Do not send medical records or copies of insurance cards in a first enquiry.
Before confirming
Review included services, exclusions and the payment, change and cancellation conditions. A suggested visit or a photograph on this website is not an included service.
Frequently asked questions
Can you advise on visas or funding?
Does the EHIC replace travel insurance?
No. It helps with necessary healthcare in covered situations but does not cover repatriation. Check your cover and consider travel insurance. See Practical information.

We are a France-based team specializing in international group programmes. We work with educational institutions, training organisations, companies, mobility partners and other organised groups looking for a reliable local contact in France. Our role is to understand your project, identify suitable solutions and coordinate the agreed services with you from the preparation stage onwards.
